messages:
emma: Heads-up — auth service started spiking 502s ~08:12 UTC. Dashboard shows a lot of 429s clustered on newly created API keys.
josh: On it. Which orgs/keys are affected?
emma: Looks like keys created since midnight. Per-org burst usage is 100% for those orgs.
alex: Any console changes recently?
pria: (typo) meant priya: This coincides with the quota API v2 rollout yesterday. Could default semantics have flipped?
josh: Pulling logs now. Quick sample: 
```
ERROR 2026-03-20T08:13:02Z auth rate_limiter.go:210 throttle=429 key=sk_live_abc org=org_47 burst=0
WARN 2026-03-20T08:13:04Z token-saver retryer.go:88 failure upstream=auth status=429 attempts=3 -> 502
```
emma: Ugh — burst=0 in the logs. That shouldn't be a thing for new keys (should inherit org defaults).
josh: Found console save payload from yesterday: `{"burst_capacity":0}` for quota defaults. New API v2 treats 0 as explicit zero. Old behaviour treated missing/null as inherit. PR#3429 added migration that set default 0.
alex: I merged that PR yesterday — I misread the migration. Starting revert now.
priya: Before full revert, can we hotpatch org-level burst to a safe value to stop immediate customer impact?
oncall: Running query: `SELECT org_id FROM quotas WHERE created_at > '2026-03-20T00:00' AND burst_capacity = 0` -> 42 orgs affected.
emma: If we can patch those quickly that's ideal. Scriptable via console admin API.
alex: I'm preparing a script to PATCH quotas for those orgs to burst_capacity=200. Will run in 2m.
infra-bot: Deploy started: quota-hotpatch script v1 -> executing on infra-ops pool.
josh: Note: our dashboards aggregated per-cluster token throughput and masked the per-org spike — the per-org panel wasn’t joined correctly due to PR#3410. That’s why page didn't hit earlier.
priya: Adding immediate alert: per-key 429 rate > 5% for 5m. Also alert on burst_capacity==0 for new keys.
alex: Hotpatch run: sample command: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -X PATCH https://console/api/orgs/org_47/quotas -d '{"burst_capacity":200}'` -> 200 OK. Applying to 42 orgs now.
emma: Errors dropping already, 502s tailing off. Monitoring shows 429 rate returning to baseline.
oncall: Keeping watch on retries. I've also enabled fallback routing to dedicated variant for noisy routes to reduce impact while we stabilize.
josh: Action items for postmortem: 1) Revert or change migration behavior for PR#3429 so default stays null/inherit. 2) Add unit/integration test for default quota semantics. 3) Fix dashboard join bug (PR#3410) and add per-key 429 alert. 4) Draft rollout checklist for quota schema migrations (feature flag + canary).
priya: Opening incident ticket INC-2026-03-20-01 and assigning alex/josh.
alex: Sorry folks — I'll draft the postmortem and a corrective PR with tests.
emma: Thanks. I'll leave this channel open for another hour while metrics settle. :thumbsup:
summary: Hotpatch applied after quota migration set burst_capacity=0 for new keys; resulted in 429s and downstream 502s. 42 orgs patched to burst_capacity=200. Postmortem and alerts planned.
